def prefix_hardware(args, pin):
    """Bind the real new core build and its actual smoke; never forge an old report."""
    core = args.prefix_core_build.resolve()
    report_path = args.prefix_smoke_result.resolve()
    need(core == PREFIX_ROOT/'core-build-02' and report_path == PREFIX_ROOT/'core-smoke-02/result.json',
         'one reviewed closed prefix build and smoke only')
    pin(core/'result.json', PREFIX_BUILD_SHA)
    pin(report_path, PREFIX_SMOKE_SHA)
    smoke = read(report_path)
    need(smoke['schema'] == 'dot16-prefix-external-core-smoke-v1'
         and smoke['status'] == 'PREFIX_FULLCORE_SIX_CASE_SMOKE_PASS'
         and smoke['fullcore_smoke_qualified'] and smoke['inputs_unchanged'] and smoke['all_children_reaped']
         and smoke['abi_layout'] == ABI and smoke['core_result_sha256'] == PREFIX_BUILD_SHA
         and smoke['core_build'] == str(core), 'actual new prefix smoke and ABI identity')
    need([c['name'] for c in smoke['commands']] ==
         ['check-inputs-before','abi-build','abi-run','emulator','check-inputs-after']
         and all(c['exit_code'] == 0 and c['reaped'] and c['group_absent'] for c in smoke['commands']),
         'closed actual five-command smoke')
    runtime_path = pin(report_path.parent/'runtime-inputs.json', PREFIX_RUNTIME_SHA)
    need(smoke['runtime_inputs_sha256'] == PREFIX_RUNTIME_SHA, 'actual runtime pin record binding')
    runtime = read(runtime_path)
    need(len(runtime) == 24, 'complete original runtime pin set')
    for path,h in runtime.items(): pin(path,h)
    checker_path = pin(report_path.parent/'source-snapshot/prefix_core_smoke.py', PREFIX_CHECKER_SHA)
    checker = module(checker_path,'prefix_existing_build_record',PREFIX_CHECKER_SHA)
    record,builder,actual_emu,header = checker.build_record(core,PREFIX_BUILD_SHA)
    need(record['emu']['sha256'] == EMU_SHA and record['emu']['bytes'] == 71489976
         and smoke['emu'] == record['emu'] and digest(header) == PREFIX_HEADER_SHA,
         'new physical EMU and generated ABI header')
    pin(builder,checker.BUILDER_SHA);pin(header,PREFIX_HEADER_SHA)
    plan = read(pin(core/'plan.json',PREFIX_PLAN_SHA))
    need(all({k:plan[env][k] for k in FLAGS} == FLAGS for env in ('environment','generation_environment')),
         'actual build plan feature and trace flags')

         and '--enable-difftest' in java, 'same one-core MinimalConfig with DiffTest')
    need(all(x in plan['native'] for x in ('NUM_CORES=1','EMU_THREADS=1','NO_DIFF=0','EMU_TRACE=0',
